dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal widest point toward the posterior edge.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Symmetric and smooth lateral margins without visible structural deviations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate-gray median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between darker mottled regions and the gray baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single dark longitudinal linear mark on the right side of the mid-dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: One visible longitudinal linear scratch on the right dorsal flank.
